tools.name: uae_aeronautical_publications
tools.title: Aeronautical Publications
tools.description: List current GCAA eAIP publication-index entries and their source-native dates. Discovery only: not NOTAM, flight-planning data, operational guidance, regulatory interpretation, or a substitute for the current official AIP package.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_ajman_business_evidence
tools.title: Ajman Business Evidence
tools.description: Explore three distinct official Ajman business-license dataset samples by activity, area, legal form, license type and published status. Samples are not unique-company counts, market size or investment advice.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_ajman_parks_footfall
tools.title: Ajman Parks Footfall
tools.description: Read official Ajman monthly park-visit observations by year and source-native park label. Visit counts are not unique people, resident demand, tourism performance, satisfaction, capacity or park quality.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_ajman_urban_evidence
tools.title: Ajman Urban Evidence
tools.description: Read six distinct official Ajman building, certified-rent and road datasets as source-native annual series. Measures remain separate and are not a property index, investment return or growth score.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_business_setup
tools.title: Business Setup
tools.description: Route a founder to the competent official UAE business-setup authority by emirate and mainland/free-zone path. Read-only, informational, no intermediaries and no personal data stored.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_connectivity_pulse
tools.title: Connectivity Pulse
tools.description: Read three separate official TDRA monthly connectivity series through December 2025: active mobile subscriptions, broadband subscriptions per 100 inhabitants and fixed lines per 100 inhabitants. Subscriptions are not unique people and the per-100 series do not measure coverage, speed, quality or affordability.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_dashboard_summary
tools.title: Dashboard Summary
tools.description: Concurrent, cached health snapshot across all sources (fast, never stalls).
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_dataset_schema
tools.title: Dataset Schema
tools.description: Inspect a live dataset schema before filtering or aggregation. Returns inferred types, examples, semantic meaning, nullability, uniqueness and sample statistics.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_dataset_snapshot
tools.title: Dataset Snapshot
tools.description: Create, list, or diff historical dataset snapshots. create is a protected write action; list and diff are open reads.
limitations: Write-capable tools require a server-side write token and cannot run in the public browser playground.

tools.name: uae_education_ledger
tools.title: Education Ledger
tools.description: Read the accredited UAE 2023/2024 national education snapshot and the separate Ministry of Education 2018–2024 resource catalogue. Includes reconciliation checks, source SHA-256, methodology and limitations; it is not a live enrollment feed.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_employment_gender
tools.title: Employment Gender
tools.description: Read official MOHRE annual male/female ratios for employees registered in private-sector systems from 2020–2024. Ratios are not employee counts or a total for all UAE employment.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_entity_resolve
tools.title: Entity Resolve
tools.description: Resolve matching entities across two bounded source samples using explicit bilingual-normalized exact field mappings.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_evidence_dossier
tools.title: Evidence Dossier
tools.description: Compose two to five official UAE evidence pillars into one bilingual, source-cited dossier. Keeps periods and units separate, reports unavailable evidence explicitly, and never produces a ranking or composite score.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_founder_pathway
tools.title: Founder Pathway
tools.description: Build one ordered, privacy-bounded UAE founder journey across official business setup, relevant government-backed startup support and entrepreneur Golden Residency readiness. Planning only; no application, eligibility decision or personal data storage.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_golden_residency
tools.title: Golden Residency
tools.description: Explore current official UAE Golden Residency pathways or assess non-identifying evidence readiness. Informational only: never determines eligibility, submits an application, stores personal data, or guarantees approval.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_health_facilities_atlas
tools.title: Health Facilities Atlas
tools.description: Explore official MOHAP aggregate facility counts for 2015–2024 by emirate, sector, category and type. Rows are not individual facilities; results do not measure beds, capacity, access or quality.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_health_facilities_map
tools.title: Health Facilities Map
tools.description: Search and spatially filter the official MOHAP 2026 health-facility location workbook as privacy-bounded map features. Direct contact fields are removed; published and mappable row counts remain explicit, and missing locations are never treated as zero facilities.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_health_indicators
tools.title: Health Indicators
tools.description: Search official MOHAP health core indicator rows across published year columns. Values are source-native and not silently normalized; the response states mixed ratio/percentage scale and period limitations.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_indicator
tools.title: Indicator
tools.description: List or calculate a methodology-backed UAE data indicator with evidence, limitations and citations.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_industry_atlas
tools.title: Industry Atlas
tools.description: Build an evidence-backed UAE industrial-establishment atlas from a bounded official MOIAT sample. Counts are never presented as population totals without upstream coverage proof.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_intelligence_recipe
tools.title: Intelligence Recipe
tools.description: Run an evidence-backed analytical recipe. Results include methodology, evidence, limitations and citations.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_market_snapshot
tools.title: Market Snapshot
tools.description: Build a source-backed market snapshot (counts by emirate/area/product).
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_national_evidence_brief
tools.title: National Evidence Brief
tools.description: Read education, health, industry and FTA service activity side by side with source-native units, periods, citations and explicit limitations. No composite score or cross-pillar ranking is produced.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_observatory
tools.title: Observatory
tools.description: Read the UAE Open Data Observatory: national reliability report, derived incidents, or one source reliability profile. Uses stored observations and never triggers hidden upstream work.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_place_names
tools.title: Place Names
tools.description: Search the official FGIC National Gazetteer for bilingual UAE place names and coordinates. Returns a bounded, normalized, source-cited evidence product; points are not an authoritative boundary reference.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_policy_evidence_watch
tools.title: Policy Evidence Watch
tools.description: Read retained checks or run a bounded check across five audited official UAE legislation, tax, labour, residency and Cabinet pages. Detects published-page content changes only; it never determines legal effect, effective date or eligibility.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_products_list
tools.title: Products List
tools.description: List the public Open Emirates Intelligence applications with bilingual descriptions, routes, official evidence scope and explicit limitations.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_search
tools.title: Search
tools.description: Federated bilingual (ar/en) search across the catalog. With deep=true it also searches each portal's live dataset catalogue.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_source_add
tools.title: Source Add
tools.description: [WRITE — requires token] Register a custom source using a built-in or installed connector plugin.
limitations: Write-capable tools require a server-side write token and cannot run in the public browser playground.

tools.name: uae_source_add_metadata
tools.title: Source Add Metadata
tools.description: [WRITE — requires token] Add a metadata-only source to the local registry.
limitations: Write-capable tools require a server-side write token and cannot run in the public browser playground.

tools.name: uae_source_aggregate
tools.title: Source Aggregate
tools.description: Group records and reduce with count|sum|avg|min|max. group_by is a comma-separated list of fields (dotted paths allowed). A generalized uae_market_snapshot.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_source_datasets
tools.title: Source Datasets
tools.description: List the datasets inside a multi-dataset portal (CKAN/OpenDataSoft/ArcGIS). Use a returned id as `dataset` for uae_source_records.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_source_geo
tools.title: Source Geo
tools.description: Spatially-filtered records as GeoJSON — powers map apps. bbox='min_lon,min_lat,max_lon,max_lat'; near='lat,lon,radius_km'.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_source_get
tools.title: Source Get
tools.description: Get the full metadata for one source by id.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_source_health
tools.title: Source Health
tools.description: Run a live, timeout-bounded health probe for one source.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_source_records
tools.title: Source Records
tools.description: Fetch up to `limit` live, redacted, source-cited records. For multi-dataset portals pass `dataset` (from uae_source_datasets). Response meta carries provenance + a data-quality block.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_sources_list
tools.title: Sources List
tools.description: List every registered official UAE open-data source with its metadata.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_spatial_join
tools.title: Spatial Join
tools.description: Join point records from two official sources when they fall within radius_km. Both samples and output are strictly bounded.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_startup_support
tools.title: Startup Support
tools.description: Discover current official or government-backed UAE startup support programmes by stage, support need and emirate. Relevance only: never determines eligibility, funding approval or acceptance and stores no personal data.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_tax_service_activity
tools.title: Tax Service Activity
tools.description: Read the official FTA 2025 service-activity report with quarterly totals, methodology, limitations and citation. Counts are not tax revenue, taxpayers, companies, or economic growth.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_tax_service_archive
tools.title: Tax Service Archive
tools.description: Read the official FTA source-native service workbooks for 2017–2022, 2024 and 2025. Cross-year comparison is deliberately unavailable because scopes and schemas differ and 2023 is missing.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_tourism_pulse
tools.title: Tourism Pulse
tools.description: Read five separate official UAE Ministry of Economy and Tourism national annual hotel-sector series for 2014–2025. Values retain source-native units; guest arrivals are not necessarily unique tourists, and descriptive trends do not establish causality, profitability or future demand.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.

tools.name: uae_trade_flow_radar
tools.title: Trade Flow Radar
tools.description: Analyze bounded official Ajman 2023 certificate-of-origin export and re-export records. Returns destination, transport, HS-code, month and origin rankings with explicit sample coverage. Counts are not trade value or total UAE trade.
limitations: Results remain bounded by the cited source, its availability and its published coverage.
